Unresolved: autooptreproTest is a concurrency-race suite that can flake under full-suite load (passes in isolation and on clean runs — pre-existing, not a regression from this change).

Next: If the flaky full-suite race test ever bites in CI, add a determinism guard to the affected race test rather than re-running.

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:
Outcome: The OpenSpec change `fix-xtb-session-editing` is applied to verified completion — xTB optimization sessions now re-baseline per tick from the live molecule, drag-after-convergence works, and the press-before-move crash is fixed. All 17 tasks are done and the work is committed and pushed to origin/master.

Changed: `XtbEngine` now reads the live molecule each tick (setupFromMolecule + bounded-retry read lock), re-establishes exactly once on topology change, and adopts external moves as a fresh phase; the tool timer is a repaint pump only and the engine's snapshot-aware writeBackToMolecule is the sole molecule writer; a failed re-establishment now latches via m_setupBroken (not the converged latch) so drags can't re-arm a broken session; evaluateOnce guards a null xTB environment; translate() takes the molecule write lock.

Unresolved: autooptreproTest is a concurrency-race suite that can flake under full-suite load (passes in isolation and on clean runs — pre-existing, not a regression from this change).

Next: If the flaky full-suite race test ever bites in CI, add a determinism guard to the affected race test rather than re-running.

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:
Outcome: The OpenSpec change `fix-xtb-session-editing` is applied to verified completion — xTB optimization sessions now re-baseline per tick from the live molecule, drag-after-convergence works, and the press-before-move crash is fixed. All 17 tasks are done and the work is committed and pushed to origin/master.

Changed: `XtbEngine` now reads the live molecule each tick (setupFromMolecule + bounded-retry read lock), re-establishes exactly once on topology change, and adopts external moves as a fresh phase; the tool timer is a repaint pump only and the engine's snapshot-aware writeBackToMolecule is the sole molecule writer; a failed re-establishment now latches via m_setupBroken (not the converged latch) so drags can't re-arm a broken session; evaluateOnce guards a null xTB environment; translate() takes the molecule write lock.

Unresolved: autooptreproTest is a concurrency-race suite that can flake under full-suite load (passes in isolation and on clean runs — pre-existing, not a regression from this change).

Next: If the flaky full-suite race test ever bites in CI, add a determinism guard to the affected race test rather than re-running.

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:
Outcome: The OpenSpec change `fix-xtb-session-editing` is applied to verified completion — xTB optimization sessions now re-baseline per tick from the live molecule, drag-after-convergence works, and the press-before-move crash is fixed. All 17 tasks are done and the work is committed and pushed to origin/master.

Changed: `XtbEngine` now reads the live molecule each tick (setupFromMolecule + bounded-retry read lock), re-establishes exactly once on topology change, and adopts external moves as a fresh phase; the tool timer is a repaint pump only and the engine's snapshot-aware writeBackToMolecule is the sole molecule writer; a failed re-establishment now latches via m_setupBroken (not the converged latch) so drags can't re-arm a broken session; evaluateOnce guards a null xTB environment; translate() takes the molecule write lock.

Evidence: OpenSpec reports all_done (17/17, 0 remaining); full ctest 53/53 clean; Windows Installer CI run 43432287293 passed both build-installer jobs (MSVC Build + offscreen Test green).

Tests: affected suite green (xtbengineTest 22/22, xtbphysicsTest, xbruntimetest, autooptreproTest); full suite 53/53 on clean runs.

Unresolved: autooptreproTest is a concurrency-race suite that can flake under full-suite load (passes in isolation and on clean runs — pre-existing, not a regression from this change).

Next: If the flaky full-suite race test ever bites in CI, add a determinism guard to the affected race test rather than re-running.

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:
Outcome: The OpenSpec change `fix-xtb-session-editing` is applied to verified completion — xTB optimization sessions now re-baseline per tick from the live molecule, drag-after-convergence works, and the press-before-move crash is fixed. All 17 tasks are done and the work is committed and pushed to origin/master.

Changed: `XtbEngine` now reads the live molecule each tick (setupFromMolecule + bounded-retry read lock), re-establishes exactly once on topology change, and adopts external moves as a fresh phase; the tool timer is a repaint pump only and the engine's snapshot-aware writeBackToMolecule is the sole molecule writer; a failed re-establishment now latches via m_setupBroken (not the converged latch) so drags can't re-arm a broken session; evaluateOnce guards a null xTB environment; translate() takes the molecule write lock.

Evidence: OpenSpec reports all_done (17/17, 0 remaining); full ctest 53/53 clean; Windows Installer CI run 43432287293 passed both build-installer jobs (MSVC Build + offscreen Test green).

Tests: affected suite green (xtbengineTest 22/22, xtbphysicsTest, xbruntimetest, autooptreproTest); full suite 53/53 on clean runs.

Unresolved: autooptreproTest is a concurrency-race suite that can flake under full-suite load (passes in isolation and on clean runs — pre-existing, not a regression from this change).

Next: If the flaky full-suite race test ever bites in CI, add a determinism guard to the affected race test rather than re-running.

Outcome: The OpenSpec change `fix-xtb-session-editing` is applied to verified completion — xTB optimization sessions now re-baseline per tick from the live molecule, drag-after-convergence works, and the press-before-move crash is fixed. All 17 tasks are done and the work is committed and pushed to origin/master.

Changed: `XtbEngine` now reads the live molecule each tick (setupFromMolecule + bounded-retry read lock), re-establishes exactly once on topology change, and adopts external moves as a fresh phase; the tool timer is a repaint pump only and the engine's snapshot-aware writeBackToMolecule is the sole molecule writer; a failed re-establishment now latches via m_setupBroken (not the converged latch) so drags can't re-arm a broken session; evaluateOnce guards a null xTB environment; translate() takes the molecule write lock.

Unresolved: autooptreproTest is a concurrency-race suite that can flake under full-suite load (passes in isolation and on clean runs — pre-existing, not a regression from this change).

Next: If the flaky full-suite race test ever bites in CI, add a determinism guard to the affected race test rather than re-running.

Outcome: The OpenSpec change `fix-xtb-session-editing` is applied to verified completion — xTB optimization sessions now re-baseline per tick from the live molecule, drag-after-convergence works, and the press-before-move crash is fixed. All 17 tasks are done and the work is committed and pushed to origin/master.

Changed: `XtbEngine` now reads the live molecule each tick (setupFromMolecule + bounded-retry read lock), re-establishes exactly once on topology change, and adopts external moves as a fresh phase; the tool timer is a repaint pump only and the engine's snapshot-aware writeBackToMolecule is the sole molecule writer; a failed re-establishment now latches via m_setupBroken (not the converged latch) so drags can't re-arm a broken session; evaluateOnce guards a null xTB environment; translate() takes the molecule write lock.

Unresolved: autooptreproTest is a concurrency-race suite that can flake under full-suite load (passes in isolation and on clean runs — pre-existing, not a regression from this change).

Next: If the flaky full-suite race test ever bites in CI, add a determinism guard to the affected race test rather than re-running.

Outcome: The OpenSpec change `fix-xtb-session-editing` is applied to verified completion — xTB optimization sessions now re-baseline per tick from the live molecule, drag-after-convergence works, and the press-before-move crash is fixed. Changed: `XtbEngine` now reads the live molecule each tick (setupFromMolecule + bounded-retry read lock), re-establishes exactly once on topology change, and adopts external moves as a fresh phase; the tool timer is a repaint pump only and the engine's snapshot-aware writeBackToMolecule is the sole molecule writer; a failed re-establishment now latches via m_setupBroken (not the converged latch) so drags can't re-arm a broken session; evaluateOnce guards a null xTB environment; translate() takes the molecule write lock.

Unresolved: autooptreproTest is a concurrency-race suite that can flake under full-suite load (passes in isolation and on clean runs — pre-existing, not a regression from this change).

Next: If the flaky full-suite race test ever bites in CI, add a determinism guard to the affected race test rather than re-running.

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:
Outcome: The OpenSpec change `fix-xtb-session-editing` is applied to verified completion — xTB optimization sessions now re-baseline per tick from the live molecule, drag-after-convergence works, and the press-before-move crash is fixed. All 17 tasks are done and the work is committed and pushed to origin/master.

Changed: `XtbEngine` now reads the live molecule each tick (setupFromMolecule + bounded-retry read lock), re-establishes exactly once on topology change, and adopts external moves as a fresh phase; the tool timer is a repaint pump only and the engine's snapshot-aware writeBackToMolecule is the sole molecule writer; a failed re-establishment now latches via m_setupBroken (not the converged latch) so drags can't re-arm a broken session; evaluateOnce guards a null xTB environment; translate() takes the molecule write lock.

Evidence: OpenSpec reports all_done (17/17, 0 remaining); full ctest 53/53 clean; Windows Installer CI run 43432287293 passed both build-installer jobs (MSVC Build + offscreen Test green).

Tests: affected suite green (xtbengineTest 22/22, xtbphysicsTest, xbruntimetest, autooptreproTest); full suite 53/53 on clean runs.

Unresolved: autooptreproTest is a concurrency-race suite that can flake under full-suite load (passes in isolation and on clean runs — pre-existing, not a regression from this change).

Next: If the flaky full-suite race test ever bites in CI, add a determinism guard to the affected race test rather than re-running.

- GLLA 3 <- OpenSpec 3: [ ] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 4 <- OpenSpec 4: [ ] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

- GLLA 7 <- OpenSpec 7: [ ] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

- GLLA 11 <- OpenSpec 11: [ ] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test
- GLLA 12 <- OpenSpec 12: [ ] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 13 <- OpenSpec 13: [ ] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green
- GLLA 14 <- OpenSpec 14: [ ] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`
- GLLA 15 <- OpenSpec 15: [ ] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green

- GLLA 17 <- OpenSpec 17: [ ] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

pendingCompletion.priorCompletionSummary:
Outcome: The OpenSpec change `fix-xtb-session-editing` is applied to verified completion — xTB optimization sessions now re-baseline per tick from the live molecule, drag-after-convergence works, and the press-before-move crash is fixed. All 17 tasks are done and the work is committed and pushed to origin/master.

Changed: `XtbEngine` now reads the live molecule each tick (setupFromMolecule + bounded-retry read lock), re-establishes exactly once on topology change, and adopts external moves as a fresh phase; the tool timer is a repaint pump only and the engine's snapshot-aware writeBackToMolecule is the sole molecule writer; a failed re-establishment now latches via m_setupBroken (not the converged latch) so drags can't re-arm a broken session; evaluateOnce guards a null xTB environment; translate() takes the molecule write lock.

Evidence: OpenSpec reports all_done (17/17, 0 remaining); full ctest 53/53 clean; Windows Installer CI run 43432287293 passed both build-installer jobs (MSVC Build + offscreen Test green).

Tests: affected suite green (xtbengineTest 22/22, xtbphysicsTest, xbruntimetest, autooptreproTest); full suite 53/53 on clean runs.

Unresolved: autooptreproTest is a concurrency-race suite that can flake under full-suite load (passes in isolation and on clean runs — pre-existing, not a regression from this change).

Next: If the flaky full-suite race test ever bites in CI, add a determinism guard to the affected race test rather than re-running.

- GLLA 3 <- OpenSpec 3: [ ] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 4 <- OpenSpec 4: [ ] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

- GLLA 7 <- OpenSpec 7: [ ] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

- GLLA 11 <- OpenSpec 11: [ ] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test
- GLLA 12 <- OpenSpec 12: [ ] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 13 <- OpenSpec 13: [ ] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green
- GLLA 14 <- OpenSpec 14: [ ] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`
- GLLA 15 <- OpenSpec 15: [ ] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbenginetest|xtbphysicstest|xtbruntimetest|autooptreprotest" --output-on-failure`; all green

- GLLA 17 <- OpenSpec 17: [ ] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green. [OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test (autooptreprotest::xtbEvaluationFailedSurfacedAndCleared: drives a real xTB session through AutoOptTool, dissociates H2 to trigger an SCF failure, asserts the tool latches the reason (m_xtbEvalFailedReason) and the failed tick publishes no coords, then asserts both Stop/Start and a mid-session add-atom re-establishment clear it; ctest green)

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green. (Superseded by the single-writer decision: the tool no longer writes atoms, so the engine's snapshot-aware `writeBackToMolecule` is the sole molecule writer; the tool timer is a repaint pump only.)

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|xtbphysicsTest|xtbruntimeTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green. (Committed 57d5175e4 to master, pushed to origin/master; the Windows Installer workflow run 43432287293 auto-triggered on push and both `build-installer` jobs passed — MSVC Build + Test green, including the new xTB engine/tool tests.)

Apply the already-active OpenSpec change "fix-xtb-session-editing" to verified completion.

OpenSpec is authoritative for scope, requirements, workflow, artifacts, and task state.
Current schema: spec-driven.
Starting task progress: 17/17.

The GLLA task list is preloaded deterministically from the OpenSpec task list at goal creation.
It is a status mirror, not an independent planning source. Do not call propose_task_list merely to recreate the initial OpenSpec task breakdown.

Initial task mapping:
- GLLA 1 <- OpenSpec 1: [x] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 2 <- OpenSpec 2: [x] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3
- GLLA 3 <- OpenSpec 3: [x] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 4 <- OpenSpec 4: [x] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green
- GLLA 5 <- OpenSpec 5: [x] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build
- GLLA 6 <- OpenSpec 6: [x] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test
- GLLA 7 <- OpenSpec 7: [x] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test
- GLLA 8 <- OpenSpec 8: [x] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green
- GLLA 9 <- OpenSpec 9: [x] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 10 <- OpenSpec 10: [x] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build
- GLLA 11 <- OpenSpec 11: [x] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test (autooptreprotest::xtbEvaluationFailedSurfacedAndCleared: drives a real xTB session through AutoOptTool, dissociates H2 to trigger an SCF failure, asserts the tool latches the reason (m_xtbEvalFailedReason) and the failed tick publishes no coords, then asserts both Stop/Start and a mid-session add-atom re-establishment clear it; ctest green)
- GLLA 12 <- OpenSpec 12: [x] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`
- GLLA 13 <- OpenSpec 13: [x] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green. (Superseded by the single-writer decision: the tool no longer writes atoms, so the engine's snapshot-aware `writeBackToMolecule` is the sole molecule writer; the tool timer is a repaint pump only.)
- GLLA 14 <- OpenSpec 14: [x] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`
- GLLA 15 <- OpenSpec 15: [x] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|xtbphysicsTest|xtbruntimeTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure`; all green
- GLLA 16 <- OpenSpec 16: [x] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests
- GLLA 17 <- OpenSpec 17: [x] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green. (Committed 57d5175e4 to master, pushed to origin/master; the Windows Installer workflow run 43432287293 auto-triggered on push and both `build-installer` jobs passed — MSVC Build + Test green, including the new xTB engine/tool tests.)

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1] 1.1 Guard the pin step in `XtbEngine::evaluateOnce`: skip pinning (and the accompanying accuracy switch assumptions) when `dragPos.size() < 3`; verify by building `libavogadro` and running `xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 2] 1.2 Enforce the write-side invariant at every assignment to `m_draggedIndex` (a press without an authored position never publishes an index): audit `setDraggedAtom` / `notifyDragPosition` / any tool path; verify by code inspection notes in the PR plus 1.3

[OpenSpec 3] 1.3 Add the engine-level crash regression to `xtbenginetest`: water session started, worker running, `setDraggedAtom(0)` with no position, request a tick, pump to completion — pre-fix this faults at the null vector read (cdb frame `evaluateOnce+0x18b`); post-fix it passes and coordinates still publish; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 4] 2.1 Add the optional molecule source to `XtbEngine` (`setupFromMolecule(Molecule*)`, cleared on quiesce) while keeping the headless vector setup for tests; verify build + existing `xtbenginetest` green

[OpenSpec 5] 2.2 Implement the per-tick worker read: bounded-retry `tryLockForRead` with `std::this_thread::yield` and stop-bail, named-constructor RAII holder (MSVC rule), copy positions Å→bohr under the lock; verify by code inspection against the `AutoOptThread::update` pattern and a passing build

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 10] 3.1 Add the post-singlepoint environment check and finiteness check (energy, gradient, coordinates) in `evaluateOnce`; failed ticks publish nothing and latch the phase idle-with-failure via a new `evaluationFailed(reason)` signal; verify build

[OpenSpec 11] 3.2 Surface the failure in the AutoOpt HUD via the existing setup-failure plumbing pattern (reason text in the on-screen status); Stop/Start and topology re-establishment clear it; verify by tool-level test (autooptreprotest::xtbEvaluationFailedSurfacedAndCleared: drives a real xTB session through AutoOptTool, dissociates H2 to trigger an SCF failure, asserts the tool latches the reason (m_xtbEvalFailedReason) and the failed tick publishes no coords, then asserts both Stop/Start and a mid-session add-atom re-establishment clear it; ctest green)

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 13] 4.1 Simplify the AutoOpt xTB timer path: keep `requestTick`/`takeLatestCoords`, keep the size guard as a safety net with a one-shot diagnostic (no longer silently permanent), keep the dragged-atom skip and write-lock discipline; drop non-finite snapshots defensively; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green. (Superseded by the single-writer decision: the tool no longer writes atoms, so the engine's snapshot-aware `writeBackToMolecule` is the sole molecule writer; the tool timer is a repaint pump only.)

[OpenSpec 14] 4.2 Add tool-level scenarios to `autooptreprotest` with synthesized events: draw-atom during xTB → write-back continues and no atom freezes; erase during xTB → survivors keep moving; undo/redo during xTB → no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R autooptreprotest`

[OpenSpec 15] 5.1 Run the full affected test suite locally: `cmake --build build --parallel && ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|xtbphysicsTest|xtbruntimeTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure`; all green
[OpenSpec 16] 5.2 Run the full ctest suite; no regressions in previously passing tests

[OpenSpec 17] 5.3 Push the branch and trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`); verify the MSVC build compiles the new code and the offscreen ctest leg (including the new tests) is green. (Committed 57d5175e4 to master, pushed to origin/master; the Windows Installer workflow run 43432287293 auto-triggered on push and both `build-installer` jobs passed — MSVC Build + Test green, including the new xTB engine/tool tests.)

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 6] 2.3 Implement topology fingerprint (count + atomic numbers) with worker-side re-establishment (destroy/recreate the four xTB objects under `m_mutex`, re-validate elements, reset optimizer/counters) exactly once per topology change, routing failure to the failed-setup latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 7] 2.4 Implement external-position adoption: epsilon diff (1e-6 bohr, dragged atom excluded) → reset L-BFGS history, clear `m_initialEvalDone`, zero eval counter, clear the converged latch; verify with the 2.6 test

[OpenSpec 8] 2.5 Dissolve the position side channel: delete `notifyDragPosition` and `m_dragPositionBohr`; reduce `setDraggedAtom` to index-only masking (gradient zeroing, write-back skip, interactive accuracy); update `AutoOptTool` mouse handlers and remove the D1-transition guards that no longer have a position channel to guard; verify build + `autooptreprotest` green

[OpenSpec 9] 2.6 Add re-baseline tests to `xtbenginetest` (molecule-source mode): add-atom mid-session → exactly one re-establishment and new atom evaluated; remove-atom → survivors keep publishing; element change → new element evaluated; external move (including after convergence) → fresh phase adopted, no snap-back; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

[OpenSpec 12] 3.3 Add the containment test: drive a failing/non-finite evaluation, assert no publish (`takeLatestCoords` returns false), latch engaged, and recovery after Stop/Start; verify with `ctest -R xtbenginetest`

pendingCompletion.completionSummary: Outcome: The XTB drag-pause bug is fixed and the fix-xtb-drag-pause OpenSpec change is fully implemented and verified. Changed: an xTB session no longer latches the converged/cap idle mid-drag, so a held pull keeps relaxing at interactive accuracy; a long continuous drag keeps evaluating (drag-scoped eval counter); release re-baselines with one elevated-SCF attempt so a strained geometry recovers while a dissociated geometry is contained with a named recovery path; and the AutoOpt HUD reports drag-time bond strain (naming the dragged atom) that clears at release. Evidence: commits b29c80bc5 (source) and 13ce3868f (tasks.md) on origin/master; full ctest 53/53; Windows Installer run 43522839848 success with both jobs green; Qt6 CI run 43522839834 success. Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` = 53/53 pass; `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure` = 2/2 pass; `autooptreproTest` 35/35 and `xtbengineTest` green. Unresolved: none (reviewer's P2 press-flag fix applied; redundant dispatch CI run canceled). Next: none.
pendingCompletion.verificationSummary: OpenSpec: openspec instructions apply --change fix-xtb-drag-pause --json reports progress 11/11 complete, remaining 0; openspec status reports isPlanningComplete=true, isComplete=true. D1-D4 engine implementation in libavogadro/src/xtb/xtbengine.{h,cpp}: all four idle-latch sites gated on m_draggedIndex < 0 (converged-skip ~:975, baseline-check ~:1013, post-step ~:1054, cap ~:1075); D2 eval-counter reset on pointer movement in the re-baseline drag block; D3 kXtbReleaseMaxIter = 2*kXtbDefaultMaxIter consumed exactly once in evaluateOnce; D4 recovery clause appended in latchEvaluationFailure. Reviewer P2 fix: m_releaseElevatedIter cleared in the press branch of setDraggedAtom. D5 HUD strain in libavogadro/src/tools/autoopttool.{h,cpp} (bondStrainText + paint() drawText). Tests: xtbenginetest adds dragHoldDefersConvergence, dragLongCapDeferral, dragReleaseThenIdleConverges, dragReleaseStrainedConverges, dragReleaseDissociatedLatchesWithRecovery; autooptreprotest adds xtbHoldPullKeepsPublishingAndStrainHud (strain appears, no mid-drag freeze via XtbEngine::progress spy, dragged atom pinned, strain clears at release). Local: full ctest 53/53 (xvfb); affected suite 2/2. CI: Windows Installer run 43522839848 conclusion=success (build-installer tests + installer jobs both success, covering the MSVC compile and offscreen ctest leg); Qt6 CI run 43522839834 conclusion=success. Working tree for all six source/test files plus the change dir is clean; origin/master at 13ce3868f.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary: Outcome: The XTB drag-pause bug is fixed and the fix-xtb-drag-pause OpenSpec change is fully implemented and verified. Changed: an xTB session no longer latches the converged/cap idle mid-drag, so a held pull keeps relaxing at interactive accuracy; a long continuous drag keeps evaluating (drag-scoped eval counter); release re-baselines with one elevated-SCF attempt so a strained geometry recovers while a dissociated geometry is contained with a named recovery path; and the AutoOpt HUD reports drag-time bond strain (naming the dragged atom) that clears at release. Evidence: commits b29c80bc5 (source) and 13ce3868f (tasks.md) on origin/master; full ctest 53/53; Windows Installer run 43522839848 success with both jobs green; Qt6 CI run 43522839834 success. Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` = 53/53 pass; `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure` = 2/2 pass; `autooptreproTest` 35/35 and `xtbengineTest` green. Unresolved: none (reviewer's P2 press-flag fix applied; redundant dispatch CI run canceled). Next: none.
pendingCompletion.verificationSummary: OpenSpec: openspec instructions apply --change fix-xtb-drag-pause --json reports progress 11/11 complete, remaining 0; openspec status reports isPlanningComplete=true, isComplete=true. D1-D4 engine implementation in libavogadro/src/xtb/xtbengine.{h,cpp}: all four idle-latch sites gated on m_draggedIndex < 0 (converged-skip ~:975, baseline-check ~:1013, post-step ~:1054, cap ~:1075); D2 eval-counter reset on pointer movement in the re-baseline drag block; D3 kXtbReleaseMaxIter = 2*kXtbDefaultMaxIter consumed exactly once in evaluateOnce; D4 recovery clause appended in latchEvaluationFailure. Reviewer P2 fix: m_releaseElevatedIter cleared in the press branch of setDraggedAtom. D5 HUD strain in libavogadro/src/tools/autoopttool.{h,cpp} (bondStrainText + paint() drawText). Tests: xtbenginetest adds dragHoldDefersConvergence, dragLongCapDeferral, dragReleaseThenIdleConverges, dragReleaseStrainedConverges, dragReleaseDissociatedLatchesWithRecovery; autooptreprotest adds xtbHoldPullKeepsPublishingAndStrainHud (strain appears, no mid-drag freeze via XtbEngine::progress spy, dragged atom pinned, strain clears at release). Local: full ctest 53/53 (xvfb); affected suite 2/2. CI: Windows Installer run 43522839848 conclusion=success (build-installer tests + installer jobs both success, covering the MSVC compile and offscreen ctest leg); Qt6 CI run 43522839834 conclusion=success. Working tree for all six source/test files plus the change dir is clean; origin/master at 13ce3868f.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary: Outcome: The XTB drag-pause bug is fixed and the fix-xtb-drag-pause OpenSpec change is fully implemented and verified. Changed: an xTB session no longer latches the converged/cap idle mid-drag, so a held pull keeps relaxing at interactive accuracy; a long continuous drag keeps evaluating (drag-scoped eval counter); release re-baselines with one elevated-SCF attempt so a strained geometry recovers while a dissociated geometry is contained with a named recovery path; and the AutoOpt HUD reports drag-time bond strain (naming the dragged atom) that clears at release. Evidence: commits b29c80bc5 (source) and 13ce3868f (tasks.md) on origin/master; full ctest 53/53; Windows Installer run 43522839848 success with both jobs green; Qt6 CI run 43522839834 success. Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` = 53/53 pass; `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure` = 2/2 pass; `autooptreproTest` 35/35 and `xtbengineTest` green. Unresolved: none (reviewer's P2 press-flag fix applied; redundant dispatch CI run canceled). Next: none.
pendingCompletion.verificationSummary: OpenSpec: openspec instructions apply --change fix-xtb-drag-pause --json reports progress 11/11 complete, remaining 0; openspec status reports isPlanningComplete=true, isComplete=true. D1-D4 engine implementation in libavogadro/src/xtb/xtbengine.{h,cpp}: all four idle-latch sites gated on m_draggedIndex < 0 (converged-skip ~:975, baseline-check ~:1013, post-step ~:1054, cap ~:1075); D2 eval-counter reset on pointer movement in the re-baseline drag block; D3 kXtbReleaseMaxIter = 2*kXtbDefaultMaxIter consumed exactly once in evaluateOnce; D4 recovery clause appended in latchEvaluationFailure. Reviewer P2 fix: m_releaseElevatedIter cleared in the press branch of setDraggedAtom. D5 HUD strain in libavogadro/src/tools/autoopttool.{h,cpp} (bondStrainText + paint() drawText). Tests: xtbenginetest adds dragHoldDefersConvergence, dragLongCapDeferral, dragReleaseThenIdleConverges, dragReleaseStrainedConverges, dragReleaseDissociatedLatchesWithRecovery; autooptreprotest adds xtbHoldPullKeepsPublishingAndStrainHud (strain appears, no mid-drag freeze via XtbEngine::progress spy, dragged atom pinned, strain clears at release). Local: full ctest 53/53 (xvfb); affected suite 2/2. CI: Windows Installer run 43522839848 conclusion=success (build-installer tests + installer jobs both success, covering the MSVC compile and offscreen ctest leg); Qt6 CI run 43522839834 conclusion=success. Working tree for all six source/test files plus the change dir is clean; origin/master at 13ce3868f.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary: Outcome: The XTB drag-pause bug is fixed and the fix-xtb-drag-pause OpenSpec change is fully implemented and verified. Changed: an xTB session no longer latches the converged/cap idle mid-drag, so a held pull keeps relaxing at interactive accuracy; a long continuous drag keeps evaluating (drag-scoped eval counter); release re-baselines with one elevated-SCF attempt so a strained geometry recovers while a dissociated geometry is contained with a named recovery path; and the AutoOpt HUD reports drag-time bond strain (naming the dragged atom) that clears at release. Evidence: commits b29c80bc5 (source) and 13ce3868f (tasks.md) on origin/master; full ctest 53/53; Windows Installer run 43522839848 success with both jobs green; Qt6 CI run 43522839834 success. Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` = 53/53 pass; `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure` = 2/2 pass; `autooptreproTest` 35/35 and `xtbengineTest` green. Unresolved: none (reviewer's P2 press-flag fix applied; redundant dispatch CI run canceled). Next: none.
pendingCompletion.verificationSummary: OpenSpec: openspec instructions apply --change fix-xtb-drag-pause --json reports progress 11/11 complete, remaining 0; openspec status reports isPlanningComplete=true, isComplete=true. D1-D4 engine implementation in libavogadro/src/xtb/xtbengine.{h,cpp}: all four idle-latch sites gated on m_draggedIndex < 0 (converged-skip ~:975, baseline-check ~:1013, post-step ~:1054, cap ~:1075); D2 eval-counter reset on pointer movement in the re-baseline drag block; D3 kXtbReleaseMaxIter = 2*kXtbDefaultMaxIter consumed exactly once in evaluateOnce; D4 recovery clause appended in latchEvaluationFailure. Reviewer P2 fix: m_releaseElevatedIter cleared in the press branch of setDraggedAtom. D5 HUD strain in libavogadro/src/tools/autoopttool.{h,cpp} (bondStrainText + paint() drawText). Tests: xtbenginetest adds dragHoldDefersConvergence, dragLongCapDeferral, dragReleaseThenIdleConverges, dragReleaseStrainedConverges, dragReleaseDissociatedLatchesWithRecovery; autooptreprotest adds xtbHoldPullKeepsPublishingAndStrainHud (strain appears, no mid-drag freeze via XtbEngine::progress spy, dragged atom pinned, strain clears at release). Local: full ctest 53/53 (xvfb); affected suite 2/2. CI: Windows Installer run 43522839848 conclusion=success (build-installer tests + installer jobs both success, covering the MSVC compile and offscreen ctest leg); Qt6 CI run 43522839834 conclusion=success. Working tree for all six source/test files plus the change dir is clean; origin/master at 13ce3868f.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary: Outcome: The XTB drag-pause bug is fixed and the fix-xtb-drag-pause OpenSpec change is fully implemented and verified. Changed: an xTB session no longer latches the converged/cap idle mid-drag, so a held pull keeps relaxing at interactive accuracy; a long continuous drag keeps evaluating (drag-scoped eval counter); release re-baselines with one elevated-SCF attempt so a strained geometry recovers while a dissociated geometry is contained with a named recovery path; and the AutoOpt HUD reports drag-time bond strain (naming the dragged atom) that clears at release. Evidence: commits b29c80bc5 (source) and 13ce3868f (tasks.md) on origin/master; full ctest 53/53; Windows Installer run 43522839848 success with both jobs green; Qt6 CI run 43522839834 success. Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` = 53/53 pass; `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure` = 2/2 pass; `autooptreproTest` 35/35 and `xtbengineTest` green. Unresolved: none (reviewer's P2 press-flag fix applied; redundant dispatch CI run canceled). Next: none.
pendingCompletion.verificationSummary: OpenSpec: openspec instructions apply --change fix-xtb-drag-pause --json reports progress 11/11 complete, remaining 0; openspec status reports isPlanningComplete=true, isComplete=true. D1-D4 engine implementation in libavogadro/src/xtb/xtbengine.{h,cpp}: all four idle-latch sites gated on m_draggedIndex < 0 (converged-skip ~:975, baseline-check ~:1013, post-step ~:1054, cap ~:1075); D2 eval-counter reset on pointer movement in the re-baseline drag block; D3 kXtbReleaseMaxIter = 2*kXtbDefaultMaxIter consumed exactly once in evaluateOnce; D4 recovery clause appended in latchEvaluationFailure. Reviewer P2 fix: m_releaseElevatedIter cleared in the press branch of setDraggedAtom. D5 HUD strain in libavogadro/src/tools/autoopttool.{h,cpp} (bondStrainText + paint() drawText). Tests: xtbenginetest adds dragHoldDefersConvergence, dragLongCapDeferral, dragReleaseThenIdleConverges, dragReleaseStrainedConverges, dragReleaseDissociatedLatchesWithRecovery; autooptreprotest adds xtbHoldPullKeepsPublishingAndStrainHud (strain appears, no mid-drag freeze via XtbEngine::progress spy, dragged atom pinned, strain clears at release). Local: full ctest 53/53 (xvfb); affected suite 2/2. CI: Windows Installer run 43522839848 conclusion=success (build-installer tests + installer jobs both success, covering the MSVC compile and offscreen ctest leg); Qt6 CI run 43522839834 conclusion=success. Working tree for all six source/test files plus the change dir is clean; origin/master at 13ce3868f.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary: Outcome: The XTB drag-pause bug is fixed and the fix-xtb-drag-pause OpenSpec change is fully implemented and verified. Changed: an xTB session no longer latches the converged/cap idle mid-drag, so a held pull keeps relaxing at interactive accuracy; a long continuous drag keeps evaluating (drag-scoped eval counter); release re-baselines with one elevated-SCF attempt so a strained geometry recovers while a dissociated geometry is contained with a named recovery path; and the AutoOpt HUD reports drag-time bond strain (naming the dragged atom) that clears at release. Evidence: commits b29c80bc5 (source) and 13ce3868f (tasks.md) on origin/master; full ctest 53/53; Windows Installer run 43522839848 success with both jobs green; Qt6 CI run 43522839834 success. Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` = 53/53 pass; `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure` = 2/2 pass; `autooptreproTest` 35/35 and `xtbengineTest` green. Unresolved: none (reviewer's P2 press-flag fix applied; redundant dispatch CI run canceled). Next: none.
pendingCompletion.verificationSummary: OpenSpec: openspec instructions apply --change fix-xtb-drag-pause --json reports progress 11/11 complete, remaining 0; openspec status reports isPlanningComplete=true, isComplete=true. D1-D4 engine implementation in libavogadro/src/xtb/xtbengine.{h,cpp}: all four idle-latch sites gated on m_draggedIndex < 0 (converged-skip ~:975, baseline-check ~:1013, post-step ~:1054, cap ~:1075); D2 eval-counter reset on pointer movement in the re-baseline drag block; D3 kXtbReleaseMaxIter = 2*kXtbDefaultMaxIter consumed exactly once in evaluateOnce; D4 recovery clause appended in latchEvaluationFailure. Reviewer P2 fix: m_releaseElevatedIter cleared in the press branch of setDraggedAtom. D5 HUD strain in libavogadro/src/tools/autoopttool.{h,cpp} (bondStrainText + paint() drawText). Tests: xtbenginetest adds dragHoldDefersConvergence, dragLongCapDeferral, dragReleaseThenIdleConverges, dragReleaseStrainedConverges, dragReleaseDissociatedLatchesWithRecovery; autooptreprotest adds xtbHoldPullKeepsPublishingAndStrainHud (strain appears, no mid-drag freeze via XtbEngine::progress spy, dragged atom pinned, strain clears at release). Local: full ctest 53/53 (xvfb); affected suite 2/2. CI: Windows Installer run 43522839848 conclusion=success (build-installer tests + installer jobs both success, covering the MSVC compile and offscreen ctest leg); Qt6 CI run 43522839834 conclusion=success. Working tree for all six source/test files plus the change dir is clean; origin/master at 13ce3868f.

Unresolved: none (reviewer's P2 press-flag fix applied; redundant dispatch CI run canceled). Next: none.

CI: Windows Installer run 43522839848 conclusion=success (build-installer tests + installer jobs both success, covering the MSVC compile and offscreen ctest leg); Qt6 CI run 43522839834 conclusion=success. Working tree for all six source/test files plus the change dir is clean; origin/master at 13ce3868f.

Evidence: commits b29c80bc5 (source) and 13ce3868f (tasks.md) on origin/master; full ctest 53/53; Windows Installer run 43522839848 success with both jobs green; Qt6 CI run 43522839834 success. Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` = 53/53 pass; `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure` = 2/2 pass; `autooptreproTest` 35/35 and `xtbengineTest` green. Unresolved: none (reviewer's P2 press-flag fix applied; redundant dispatch CI run canceled). Next: none.

pendingCompletion.verificationSummary: OpenSpec: openspec instructions apply --change fix-xtb-drag-pause --json reports progress 11/11 complete, remaining 0; openspec status reports isPlanningComplete=true, isComplete=true. D1-D4 engine implementation in libavogadro/src/xtb/xtbengine.{h,cpp}: all four idle-latch sites gated on m_draggedIndex < 0 (converged-skip ~:975, baseline-check ~:1013, post-step ~:1054, cap ~:1075); D2 eval-counter reset on pointer movement in the re-baseline drag block; D3 kXtbReleaseMaxIter = 2*kXtbDefaultMaxIter consumed exactly once in evaluateOnce; D4 recovery clause appended in latchEvaluationFailure. Reviewer P2 fix: m_releaseElevatedIter cleared in the press branch of setDraggedAtom. D5 HUD strain in libavogadro/src/tools/autoopttool.{h,cpp} (bondStrainText + paint() drawText). Tests: xtbenginetest adds dragHoldDefersConvergence, dragLongCapDeferral, dragReleaseThenIdleConverges, dragReleaseStrainedConverges, dragReleaseDissociatedLatchesWithRecovery; autooptreprotest adds xtbHoldPullKeepsPublishingAndStrainHud (strain appears, no mid-drag freeze via XtbEngine::progress spy, dragged atom pinned, strain clears at release). Local: full ctest 53/53 (xvfb); affected suite 2/2. CI: Windows Installer run 43522839848 conclusion=success (build-installer tests + installer jobs both success, covering the MSVC compile and offscreen ctest leg); Qt6 CI run 43522839834 conclusion=success. Working tree for all six source/test files plus the change dir is clean; origin/master at 13ce3868f.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary: Outcome: The XTB drag-pause bug is fixed and the fix-xtb-drag-pause OpenSpec change is fully implemented and verified. Changed: an xTB session no longer latches the converged/cap idle mid-drag, so a held pull keeps relaxing at interactive accuracy; a long continuous drag keeps evaluating (drag-scoped eval counter); release re-baselines with one elevated-SCF attempt so a strained geometry recovers while a dissociated geometry is contained with a named recovery path; and the AutoOpt HUD reports drag-time bond strain (naming the dragged atom) that clears at release. Evidence: commits b29c80bc5 (source) and 13ce3868f (tasks.md) on origin/master; full ctest 53/53; Windows Installer run 43522839848 success with both jobs green; Qt6 CI run 43522839834 success. Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` = 53/53 pass; `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure` = 2/2 pass; `autooptreproTest` 35/35 and `xtbengineTest` green. Unresolved: none (reviewer's P2 press-flag fix applied; redundant dispatch CI run canceled). Next: none.
pendingCompletion.verificationSummary: OpenSpec: openspec instructions apply --change fix-xtb-drag-pause --json reports progress 11/11 complete, remaining 0; openspec status reports isPlanningComplete=true, isComplete=true. D1-D4 engine implementation in libavogadro/src/xtb/xtbengine.{h,cpp}: all four idle-latch sites gated on m_draggedIndex < 0 (converged-skip ~:975, baseline-check ~:1013, post-step ~:1054, cap ~:1075); D2 eval-counter reset on pointer movement in the re-baseline drag block; D3 kXtbReleaseMaxIter = 2*kXtbDefaultMaxIter consumed exactly once in evaluateOnce; D4 recovery clause appended in latchEvaluationFailure. Reviewer P2 fix: m_releaseElevatedIter cleared in the press branch of setDraggedAtom. D5 HUD strain in libavogadro/src/tools/autoopttool.{h,cpp} (bondStrainText + paint() drawText). Tests: xtbenginetest adds dragHoldDefersConvergence, dragLongCapDeferral, dragReleaseThenIdleConverges, dragReleaseStrainedConverges, dragReleaseDissociatedLatchesWithRecovery; autooptreprotest adds xtbHoldPullKeepsPublishingAndStrainHud (strain appears, no mid-drag freeze via XtbEngine::progress spy, dragged atom pinned, strain clears at release). Local: full ctest 53/53 (xvfb); affected suite 2/2. CI: Windows Installer run 43522839848 conclusion=success (build-installer tests + installer jobs both success, covering the MSVC compile and offscreen ctest leg); Qt6 CI run 43522839834 conclusion=success. Working tree for all six source/test files plus the change dir is clean; origin/master at 13ce3868f.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary: Outcome: The XTB drag-pause bug is fixed and the fix-xtb-drag-pause OpenSpec change is fully implemented and verified. Changed: an xTB session no longer latches the converged/cap idle mid-drag, so a held pull keeps relaxing at interactive accuracy; a long continuous drag keeps evaluating (drag-scoped eval counter); release re-baselines with one elevated-SCF attempt so a strained geometry recovers while a dissociated geometry is contained with a named recovery path; and the AutoOpt HUD reports drag-time bond strain (naming the dragged atom) that clears at release. Evidence: commits b29c80bc5 (source) and 13ce3868f (tasks.md) on origin/master; full ctest 53/53; Windows Installer run 43522839848 success with both jobs green; Qt6 CI run 43522839834 success. Tests: `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` = 53/53 pass; `xvfb-run -a ctest --test-dir build -R "xtbengineTest|autooptreproTest" --output-on-failure` = 2/2 pass; `autooptreproTest` 35/35 and `xtbengineTest` green. Unresolved: none (reviewer's P2 press-flag fix applied; redundant dispatch CI run canceled). Next: none.
pendingCompletion.verificationSummary: OpenSpec: openspec instructions apply --change fix-xtb-drag-pause --json reports progress 11/11 complete, remaining 0; openspec status reports isPlanningComplete=true, isComplete=true. D1-D4 engine implementation in libavogadro/src/xtb/xtbengine.{h,cpp}: all four idle-latch sites gated on m_draggedIndex < 0 (converged-skip ~:975, baseline-check ~:1013, post-step ~:1054, cap ~:1075); D2 eval-counter reset on pointer movement in the re-baseline drag block; D3 kXtbReleaseMaxIter = 2*kXtbDefaultMaxIter consumed exactly once in evaluateOnce; D4 recovery clause appended in latchEvaluationFailure. Reviewer P2 fix: m_releaseElevatedIter cleared in the press branch of setDraggedAtom. D5 HUD strain in libavogadro/src/tools/autoopttool.{h,cpp} (bondStrainText + paint() drawText). Tests: xtbenginetest adds dragHoldDefersConvergence, dragLongCapDeferral, dragReleaseThenIdleConverges, dragReleaseStrainedConverges, dragReleaseDissociatedLatchesWithRecovery; autooptreprotest adds xtbHoldPullKeepsPublishingAndStrainHud (strain appears, no mid-drag freeze via XtbEngine::progress spy, dragged atom pinned, strain clears at release). Local: full ctest 53/53 (xvfb); affected suite 2/2. CI: Windows Installer run 43522839848 conclusion=success (build-installer tests + installer jobs both success, covering the MSVC compile and offscreen ctest leg); Qt6 CI run 43522839834 conclusion=success. Working tree for all six source/test files plus the change dir is clean; origin/master at 13ce3868f.

## Audit report — fix-xtb-drag-pause

**Scope**: the 7 changed paths + the OpenSpec verification contract. I verified every claim against the live tree, my own rebuild, my own test runs, and GitHub's CI records — not the executor's summaries.

**Source verification** (commit b29c80bc5, identical to working tree, clean):
- **D1**: all four latch sites gated on drag state — converged-skip `if ((m_converged && m_draggedIndex < 0) || m_evalFailed || m_setupBroken) continue;` (xtbengine.cpp:973-976), baseline latch `if (m_draggedIndex < 0 && !m_converged)` (:1009-1031), post-step (:1055), cap (:1077). The deferred baseline branch is a single-tick `continue` (m_initialEvalDone is phase-scoped), so deferral does not itself freeze a drag.
- **D2**: pointer-movement detection resets `m_evals = 0` in the re-baseline drag block (epsilon 1e-6 bohr, vs. working coords).
- **D3**: `kXtbReleaseMaxIter = 2 * kXtbDefaultMaxIter`; flag set on release (:274), cleared on press (:262 — the reviewer P2 fix) and setup (:151), consumed exactly once in evaluateOnce (:469-471).
- **D4**: recovery clause appended to every surfaced failure message in latchEvaluationFailure (:673-683).
- **D5**: `bondStrainText` (autoopttool.cpp:663, 1.3× covalent-radii sum, names atoms); HUD drawText only while `m_clickedAtom && m_leftButtonPressed` (:358-365), so it clears at release.
- Proposal's impact exclusions hold: commit touches only the 6 source/test files + tasks.md; no lbfgs/shim/installer changes.

**Tests**: all 6 claimed test functions exist in-tree and are behavioral (e.g. `dragHoldDefersConvergence` drives a real engine + real xtb runtime, asserts progress keeps advancing during a held pull, no `converged` mid-drag, converged engages on release — matching spec scenario "Holding a stretched pull does not idle the session").

**Independent execution**: I rebuilt (`cmake --build build --parallel 8` — clean) and ran the suites myself: affected 2/2 pass, full suite 53/53 pass. CI claims confirmed via `gh`: run 43522839848 conclusion=success (jobs `build-installer (tests): success`, `build-installer (installer): success`), run 43522839834 success, both at headSha b29c80bc5 — the exact change commit.

**Advisory (non-blocking)**: the working tree holds uncommitted archive moves of *prior* changes (`openspec/changes/{add-erase-tool,add-touch-navigation,fix-xtb-session-editing}` deleted unstaged, matching untracked `archive/<date>-<name>` copies — byte-identical to HEAD). Outside the changed paths, faithful moves, and `openspec validate` passes for the active change; no effect on subsequent verification/archive of this change.

2. Every explicit requirement and scenario in the active OpenSpec change has corresponding implementation evidence.

3. OpenSpec task completion accurately reflects the actual codebase state; no checkbox is marked complete merely because work was attempted.

4. Relevant builds, tests, and regression checks pass.

5. No known required work, implementation blocker, knowingly failing relevant test, or silently deferred required task remains.

6. A final comparison of the OpenSpec artifacts against the resulting implementation finds no substantive omission.

7. The repository is left in a coherent state suitable for subsequent OpenSpec verification/archive work.

- GLLA 5 <- OpenSpec 5: [ ] 3.1 Run the full ctest suite locally; no regressions in previously passing tests
- GLLA 6 <- OpenSpec 6: [ ] 3.2 Manual feel check on a small molecule (drag responsiveness qualitatively improved vs the
- GLLA 7 <- OpenSpec 7: [ ] 3.3 Push the branch and verify the Windows installer workflow compiles the change and the

Use the installed OpenSpec apply workflow/skill as the implementation procedure.

At the start of work, after every context compaction, after every resume, and whenever task state is uncertain:

1. Run:
   openspec status --change "fix-xtb-drag-latency" --json

2. Run:
   openspec instructions apply --change "fix-xtb-drag-latency" --json

3. Treat the returned OpenSpec state, instruction, tasks, context, operationGuidance, and contextFiles as authoritative.

4. Read all contextFiles relevant to the remaining work before modifying code.

Resume from the first genuinely incomplete task. Do not redo completed work unnecessarily.

Implement every remaining required task.

GLLA task-list synchronization is a hard, per-task requirement, using GLLA's own task tools (not prose):

- GLLA task id N mirrors exactly one OpenSpec task; its title prefix "[OpenSpec <task-id>]" names that OpenSpec task.
- When you START a mirrored OpenSpec task, call update_task_status with that GLLA id and status "in_progress".
- In the SAME turn where you legitimately flip an OpenSpec checkbox to "- [x]" (or otherwise complete that OpenSpec task), call complete_task with the corresponding GLLA id. One OpenSpec checkbox flip = one complete_task call. Never batch all syncs to the end of the session.
- When several mirrored tasks genuinely finish in one turn, one update_task_batch call is also acceptable.
- GLLA's pending-task gate REFUSES complete_goal while any mirrored GLLA task is still open — a stale mirror blocks goal completion even when OpenSpec itself is finished.
- Never mark either side complete merely because work was attempted.
- The bridge extension also mirrors OpenSpec completions into the GLLA list at turn boundaries as a safety net, but do not rely on it; keep the mirror correct yourself.

If the authoritative OpenSpec task set itself changes after attachment, do not silently ignore the difference or invent an independent plan. Reconcile against a fresh OpenSpec apply response before completion.

Run relevant builds, focused tests, integration tests, and regression checks as work progresses. Fix failures caused by this change rather than bypassing them.

Do not weaken, delete, rewrite, reinterpret, or silently defer OpenSpec requirements merely to make implementation easier.

Do not switch to a different OpenSpec change.

If OpenSpec reports state="blocked", resolve the missing required planning artifact through the OpenSpec workflow before continuing implementation. Do not invent missing requirements merely to get past the block.

If OpenSpec reports state="all_done", do not immediately declare success. Perform the final verification below first.

Before claiming completion, independently re-read:

- the current OpenSpec status;
- the current OpenSpec apply instructions;
- all relevant OpenSpec artifacts;
- the repository diff and working-tree state;
- the actual build/test/regression outputs.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: The xTB OMP environment consistency issue is fully fixed and verified on both Linux and Windows. The CRT `_environ` cache and the Win32 process environment now agree on the OMP settings, so `qgetenv` reads the same value the OMP runtime uses — resolving the reproducible xTB segfault in `XtbApi::isAvailable()` and the `threadsEnvAutoRespectsClamp` test failure.

Changed: On Windows, `setEnv` now writes both the Win32 process environment via `SetEnvironmentVariableW` and the CRT `_environ` cache via `_putenv_s` (SEH-guarded so a mixed MinGW runtime CRT write fault is non-fatal). `qgetenv`/`getenv_s` therefore sees the value the OMP runtime reads, keeping the thread count clamp test consistent.

Evidence: Commit `89409281a` on `fix-xtb-drag-latency`; Windows Installer CI run `44699076943` conclusion=success (both `build-installer (tests)` and `build-installer (installer)` jobs, incl. the offscreen ctest leg that runs `threadsEnvAutoRespectsClamp`); Qt6 CI run `44699073015` conclusion=success (all 5 jobs).

Tests: Local Linux ctest `xtbengineTest` passed; Qt6 CI `44699073015` all 5 jobs green; Windows Installer `44699076943` build-installer (tests) + build-installer (installer) both success.

Unresolved: None.
